_about: Controlled vocabulary for data/measurements.csv. Every row's metric must be a key of 'metrics'; every unit_as_published must be a key of 'units'. A unit converts to its dimension's canonical unit by the stated factor; units with factor null are kept as published and value_canonical is left empty. Edit this file to add a metric or unit; CI rejects anything not listed.

dimensions.power_unspecified: MW (the document does not say electrical or thermal)

kBtu.note: 1 kBtu = 0.29307107 kWh (ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager uses 3.412 kBtu per kWh)

aMW.note: average megawatts: annual energy divided by hours in the year

short_ton.note: US short ton; EPA's National Emissions Inventory reports in short tons

ratio.note: PUE, load factor as a fraction, or another dimensionless ratio; say which in metric_detail

money_per_unit.note: a price or rate (cents/kWh, USD/MW-day); give the unit in metric_detail

MW_unspecified.note: a permit's MW figure where the document does not state whether it is electrical output or thermal input

degF.note: kept as published; convert by (F - 32) x 5/9 in metric_detail if needed

Bcf.note: billion cubic feet of natural gas

tHM.note: metric tonnes of initial heavy metal (MTHM) in nuclear fuel

klb_U3O8e.note: thousand pounds of U3O8 equivalent; the canonical value is tonnes of U3O8 equivalent, not contained uranium (about 0.848 of it)

Mgal/yr.note: million US gallons per year (3,785.41178 m3 / 365 days)

MMBtu/h.note: million British thermal units per hour (boiler heat input)

MMBtu/d.note: million British thermal units per day, a rate of gas supply or transport

metrics.electricity_consumed: energy: electricity used over the period (metered where basis=metered)
metrics.energy_consumed_total: energy: all fuels and electricity used over the period
metrics.electricity_share: share: a subject's share of a stated electricity total (name the total in metric_detail)
metrics.electricity_sales: energy: a utility's sales over the period
metrics.average_load: power: average draw over the period
metrics.peak_demand: power: peak or billing demand; say which (billing, coincident, non-coincident) in metric_detail
metrics.contracted_capacity: power or apparent_power: capacity under contract or agreement (say which agreement type in metric_detail)
metrics.requested_capacity: power or apparent_power: capacity requested or in a connection queue
metrics.approved_capacity: power or apparent_power: capacity a regulator or utility approved or allocated
metrics.forecast_demand: power or energy or thermal_power: forecast load (MW), consumption (GWh, TWh) or thermal load for a future period
metrics.connected_capacity: power or apparent_power: grid connection capacity, substation rating
metrics.it_capacity: power: IT load capacity as stated
metrics.planned_capacity: power: announced or planned site capacity
metrics.generation_capacity: power or thermal_power: generating plant capacity, electrical or heat (not standby)
metrics.permitted_standby_generation: power: standby generators permitted (MWe, sum of unit ratings)
metrics.generator_fuel_burned: energy: fuel burned by on-site generators (thermal energy, not electricity generated); name fuels in metric_detail
metrics.natural_gas_burned: energy: natural gas burned on site
metrics.generator_hours: duration: run hours, limit or actual (say which in metric_detail)
metrics.emissions_co2e: mass: CO2-equivalent; say GWP horizon and scope in metric_detail
metrics.emissions_limit: mass: a permitted emissions cap; name the pollutant in metric_detail
metrics.water_withdrawn: volume or volume_rate: water taken, as a total or a rate
metrics.water_consumed: volume or volume_rate: water consumed (evaporated or not returned)
metrics.water_discharged: volume or volume_rate: water returned or discharged
metrics.water_rate: volume_rate: water use or allocation per day or second
metrics.water_allocation: volume or volume_rate: a permitted or allocated amount
metrics.investment: money: capital spend, announced or recorded
metrics.public_money: money: tax exemption, subsidy, abatement, grant; say which in metric_detail
metrics.cost_to_customers: money or intensity: bill impact, cost shifted, capacity-market cost (a per-unit figure uses money_per_unit)
metrics.jobs: count: jobs, stated or audited (say which in metric_detail)
metrics.customer_count: count: customers or metered accounts (say which)
metrics.share_other: share: any other percentage (say what of what in metric_detail)
metrics.heat_delivered: energy: waste heat delivered to a heat network
metrics.production_mineral: mass: mine or refinery output; name the mineral in metric_detail
metrics.waste_generated: mass: e-waste or other waste generated
metrics.hardware_lifetime: duration: server or equipment useful life
metrics.concentration: concentration: a pollutant concentration measured or limited
metrics.duration_other: duration: any other period (moratorium length, permit term)
metrics.count_other: count: any other count (say what in metric_detail)
metrics.other: anything not above; metric_detail must say what it is
metrics.permitted_generation_as_stated: power_unspecified: a permit's generator capacity where the document does not say whether it is electrical or thermal
metrics.emissions_avoided: mass: emissions a project states it avoided (not emitted); never add to emissions totals
metrics.temperature: temperature: a design or limit temperature
metrics.compute_capacity: compute: computing power (EFLOPS or similar) as stated
metrics.emissions_scope2_market: mass: Scope 2 emissions, market-based (after certificates, PPAs and supplier factors)
metrics.emissions_scope3: mass: Scope 3 emissions (say which categories in metric_detail)
metrics.certificates_used: energy or share: electricity claimed through certificates (unbundled RECs, GOs, I-RECs) or PPAs, in MWh or as a share of consumption; say which instrument in metric_detail
metrics.carbon_credits: mass: carbon credits or removals contracted, retired or claimed; say which in metric_detail
metrics.cfe_share: share: hourly carbon-free energy share or similar matching metric; say the method in metric_detail
metrics.trade_value: money: value of goods crossing a border in a period, by product code and partner, from customs statistics
metrics.trade_quantity: count or mass: quantity of goods crossing a border in a period, by product code and partner, from customs statistics
metrics.spent_fuel_stored: mass or count: spent nuclear fuel held at a site (pool and dry storage) as of a date; metric_detail says assemblies or initial heavy metal and names the inventory
metrics.uranium_purchased: mass: uranium purchased or delivered, in U3O8 equivalent; metric_detail gives origin, buyer group and delivery year
metrics.electricity_by_sourcing_method: energy or share: electricity a company attributes to a sourcing method other than a certificate or PPA in its renewable matching or market-based accounting (on-site generation, renewable content of the grid mix, or no instrument); the method in metric_detail

bases.metered: a meter reading reported to or by a regulator, statistics office or public utility
bases.filed: a figure a utility or operator filed with a regulator or grid operator (demand, forecast, contract)
bases.permitted: a limit or rating in a permit or licence
bases.inventory: a regulator's emissions or activity inventory
bases.official_statistic: a statistics office or government aggregate
bases.regulator_decision: a figure in a regulator's order or decision
bases.estimate_by_record_holder: an estimate made by the public body that published it (e.g., a market monitor's counterfactual)
bases.press_report: a figure known only through a press report of a document
bases.derived: computed by the ledger from other rows (formula in metric_detail)
bases.utility_published: a figure a public utility, public power authority or grid operator published in its own documents (board papers, updates, statistics pages, presentations, letters to a regulator)
bases.ngo_report: a figure from a non-governmental organisation's own investigation, monitoring or report
bases.peer_reviewed_study: a figure from a peer-reviewed journal article
bases.assured_disclosure: a company-reported figure covered by a third-party assurance statement; cite the statement and give its level (limited or reasonable) in notes
bases.standard_or_methodology: a figure stated in a standard-setter's, rater's or methodology document about its own rules
bases.registry_record: a record in a public registry (certificates, credits, retirements)
bases.legislative_document: a bill, rapporteur's opinion or committee report (not enacted law)

relations._about: Edges of the chain the ledger traces, mine to datacenter to end of life (sites/chain/edges.csv). Each edge reads 'from <relation> to' and needs a document.
relations.mines_for: a mine or mining company supplies ore or concentrate to a smelter or refiner
relations.refines_for: a smelter or refiner supplies metal to a component maker, chipmaker or the filer of a conflict-minerals report
relations.fabricates_for: a foundry makes chips for a chip designer or buyer
relations.supplies_memory_to: a memory maker supplies memory to a chip or system maker
relations.assembles_for: an assembler or contract manufacturer builds boards, systems or servers for a buyer
relations.ships_to: goods move from one country or port to another (customs statistics)
relations.supplies_power_to: a plant, utility or grid supplies electricity to a site or cluster
relations.contracts_power_from: a site operator holds a contract (PPA, tariff, offtake) for a plant's output
relations.supplies_water_to: a utility or source supplies water to a site
relations.supplies_fuel_to: a pipeline or supplier delivers fuel to a site's generation
relations.hosts_compute_for: a site operator runs computing for a tenant
relations.leases_site_to: a site owner leases the site or capacity to a tenant
relations.receives_end_of_life_from: a recycler or refurbisher takes hardware retired from a site or company
relations.owns: one entity owns a site or another entity
relations.packages_for: an assembly, test and packaging house (OSAT), or a packaging joint venture, packages and tests chips for a chip designer
